diff_causality.evidence: The added validation function prevents malformed numeric strings from being processed. Without this check, invalid numeric formats could cause JavaScript parsing errors or unexpected behavior during code compilation.

security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-20 requires validation of input properties before processing. Numeric values used in generated JavaScript code must conform to valid numeric syntax to prevent parsing errors.
